question: Fill the blanks to group these without adding an extra DOM node:
say: Fill the blanks to group these two tags without adding an extra element to the page.
explanation: A Fragment, written <> and </>, groups elements without leaving anything in the browser HTML tree. A div would add a node.
explainSay: Use a Fragment, the empty tags. It groups the elements without adding anything to the HTML. A div would add an extra node.
